protection_summary: Medical care and humane treatment must be provided without adverse distinction.

protection_summary: POWs are protected against violence, intimidation, insults, reprisals, and unlawful punishment.
Civilians are protected against violence, coercion, collective penalties, deportation, transfer, and unlawful confinement.
NIAC detainees retain humane treatment and judicial guarantees under Common Article 3 and customary IHL.
key_authorities: Common Article 3; Additional Protocol II; Customary IHL
